gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Wide-spaced and a bit theatrical, Metamorphous sets a high midline and softly shifting strokes up top. And Noto Sans Avestan runs a tall x-height with curves that stop short of closing, so paragraphs stay light and easy to move through.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-balines: Metamorphous carries a high midline and a restrained stroke shift. It earns its keep when set big and brief, where those generous sidebearings and soft thick-to-thin changes get room to show, while Noto Sans Balinese stays in the background.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Generous sidebearings give Metamorphous a spaced-out, commanding stance, with thins barely lighter than its thicks. Noto Sans Bamum does the quieter job, its curved strokes stopping before they turn inward and leaving big open counters in each small letter.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-bassa-v: Metamorphous has a high-set midline and a slight pinch where its curves meet straight stems, which gives it a distinctive pull. And Noto Sans Bassa Vah offers the sharpest counterpoint, a dominant midsection and open-jawed c that make the two feel like different characters.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-batak: Metamorphous shows its character in light modulation, visible mainly up close, with wide sidebearings around every letter. Noto Sans Batak takes over with a towering x-height and a generous e, so the heading's grandeur lands first and the text follows easily.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali reads with capitals barely taller than the lowercase and distinctly open letter mouths, which keeps text smooth and approachable. Size it up a touch for comfort.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksu: Noto Sans Bhaiksuki reads full-bodied, its lowercase swollen like tightly coiled rope while the apertures stay open and easy. Metamorphous sits above in a more ceremonial mood, with thins only slightly lighter than thicks and a high midline.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Commanding is the first impression of Metamorphous, with its high midline and medium stroke contrast. But Noto Sans Brahmi sets the pace for reading, a high mean line and open-ended curves keeping long paragraphs unhurried.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid carries a high-set x-height and generous space between curve ends and the stem, while Metamorphous adds a modest dip in its thin strokes. Their strongest quality is distinctive heading character over open text.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-carian: Noto Sans Carian reads crisp and clean, its terminals held apart like open scissor blades and its ascenders tucked close to the x-height line. And over a longer stretch that tidy openness stays comfortable, never crowding, while Metamorphous keeps its moderate thick and thin strokes to itself.
